data.name: NOVA ATLANTIS
data.detailed_description:
NOVA ATLANTIS

Embark on "NOVA ATLANTIS," an incredibly deep and challenging city-builder game, set during the epic journey of reconstruction for the survivors of mythological Atlantis.

The cataclysm devastated the empire, forcing the survivors to abandon the sea and seek refuge and new lands inland. You are the leader of this resilient civilization, guiding it through its greatest trial: rescuing the glory of Atlantis through meticulous management and innovation.

The Ultimate Management Test

  • Survival Logistics (50+ Resources): Your mastery will be put to the test as you manage more than 50 distinct resources, from the food supply chain to the rarest processed materials.

  • Limited Growth: The focus is on efficiency and logistics. A shortage of essential supplies or inadequate management results in mass emigration, which drastically affects the housing capacity of residences. Only a continuous and successful supply chain allows your population to grow and prosper.

  • Services and Provisioning: Keep vital services operational and ensure every citizen is well provisioned, proving your ability to sustain a civilization on the brink of collapse.

Crystal Technology and Aerial Transport

The disaster ushered in a new technological era. Crystal technology, discovered in the chaos of the cataclysm, is now the central force of the civilization:

  • Enhanced Production: The crystal provides a revolutionary energy source, capable of guaranteeing a noticeable increase in industrial production, speeding up construction and the development of new structures.

  • Aerial Mobility: Far from the sea and without islands, all movement of people and resources is done through a sophisticated aerial transport system, which is the logistical backbone of Nova Atlantis.

  • Illumination and Resilience: The crystals illuminate homes and streets, symbolizing resilience and rebirth.

Honoring the Ancient Powers

Although they have moved away from the ocean, the Atlantians cannot ignore the gods who govern the cosmos, including the principal God of the Sea.

  • Worship and Benefits: The gods have been appeased, but their favor is vital. Instead of building to avoid destruction, you must build to worship and gain benefits: diligent cult and dedication bring blessings that accelerate the progress and stability of your civilization.

Build "NOVA ATLANTIS." Raise unmatched cities, master resource management, and ensure the legendary Atlantian people flourish once more, under the light of their crystals and the favor of their gods. This is my first game, and I am eager to share this adventure with you!
